title:
Every team
optimizes locally

elements.alt: Teams optimize their own APIs independently.

elements.text: An API and an automation use different definitions of “customer”. Their outputs cannot be combined reliably.
Agree on what “customer” means, which capabilities can be reused, and who owns the shared decisions before choosing implementations.

notes: APIOps Cycles / Osaango Ltd. Method content CC-BY-SA 4.0. Original artwork retained from the supplied Pariisi-Messuvihko.pptx. Illustrative scenario, not a reported client case.
